name: Carousel
description: A set of slides shown one at a time, with previous and next arrows, dots and the arrow keys. Use it for a short set of highlights or featured content.
whenToUse: For two to five highlights or featured items on a page.
When each slide is a self-contained message or picture.

whenNotToUse.text: For a long list of items to browse.
For slides that must play without interaction.
For switching between views of the same content.

anatomy.name: Dots
anatomy.description: One per slide; the current one is filled.

values.meaning: Dots only, for a compact row.

states.name: Current
states.meaning: The slide on show; its dot is filled.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: A focus ring on the carousel or a control.

behavior.text: The arrows and dots are buttons in the tab order; Enter or Space moves to a slide.
Moving past the last slide returns to the first, and back.
Each slide is announced as “n of total” when it changes.
Previous and next swap sides in Arabic, and the arrow keys follow.

content: Keep each slide’s message to one idea.
Name the carousel by what it shows, e.g. "Highlights".

guidelines.do: Keep to a few slides, two to five.
guidelines.dont: Put twenty slides in one carousel.
guidelines.why: People rarely go past the first few slides.

guidelines.do: Give every slide a visible control or a way to reach it.
guidelines.dont: Hide the controls and rely on swiping.
guidelines.why: Not every device swipes, and keyboard users need the arrows.

guidelines.do: Put the most important message on the first slide.
guidelines.dont: Hide the key message on the fourth slide.
guidelines.why: Most people only see the first slide.

accessibility.role: region with roledescription "carousel"; each slide is a group with roledescription "slide".

keyboard.action: Moves to the previous arrow, the dots, then the next arrow.
Activates an arrow or dot to show that slide.

aria.when: Polite, on the slide, so the new slide is announced.
On the dot for the current slide.

accessibility.focus: The carousel and each control show a focus ring.

wcag.how: Slides move with the arrow keys and every control is reachable by Tab.
Slide changes are announced politely without moving focus.

notes: Only the current slide is shown, so non-current slides are not read out.

examples.title: Highlights
examples.description: Three highlights with arrows and dots.
examples.code:
import { Carousel } from '@ds/react';

<Carousel label="Highlights" slides={[<Highlight key="a" />, <Highlight key="b" />, <Highlight key="c" />]} />

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: The current slide lives in your state.
examples.code:
import { Carousel } from '@ds/react';

<Carousel label="Offers" slides={offers} index={index} onIndexChange={setIndex} />

examples.title: Arrows only
examples.description: For a large set of slides.
examples.code:
import { Carousel } from '@ds/react';

<Carousel label="Gallery" slides={images} controls="arrows" />

related.relation: For switching between views of one thing.

components.name: Carousel
components.description:
A set of slides shown one at a time, with arrows, dots and the arrow keys. Use it for a short
set of highlights; every slide stays in the page order for screen readers.

controls.description: Which controls show: arrows and dots (default), arrows only, or dots only.

slideLabel.description: Words for a slide’s name. Default "{n} of {total}".

--carousel-gap.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--carousel-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--carousel-slide-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--carousel-dots-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--carousel-dot-color.description: Outline of text fields, selects and comboboxes; the lightest gray with 3:1 contrast.

--carousel-dot-active-color.description: Fill of filled buttons; the accent in light mode, a darker step in dark mode.

--carousel-duration.description: Small state changes: hover, press, toggle.

--carousel-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.

--carousel-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--carousel-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--carousel-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.
